Literal.Value: 'A graveyard of every fear named by 105 people. Sixteen fears nobody holds any more stand as headstones; seven of the nine biggest are Halloween''s own: demons, basements, being watched, cemeteries, aliens, clowns, dolls. Forty-seven fears still burn as candles, tallest war (19 people now), uncertainty about the future (14) and death (12); a flame means some kept the fear since childhood. Eight fears rise as ghosts because nobody had them as children, led by financial insecurity (11).'
